def t_crit(F):
    """Hours of sustained flow F (mL/100 g/min) tolerated before infarction (monotone)."""
    F = np.asarray(F, dtype=float)
    lt = np.interp(F, _F_ANCH, _LT_ANCH,
                   left=_LT_ANCH[0] + _SLOPE_LO * (F.min() - _F_ANCH[0]) * 0,
                   right=_LT_ANCH[-1])
    lt = np.where(F < _F_ANCH[0], _LT_ANCH[0] + _SLOPE_LO * (F - _F_ANCH[0]), lt)
    lt = np.where(F > _F_ANCH[-1], _LT_ANCH[-1] + _SLOPE_HI * (F - _F_ANCH[-1]), lt)
    out = np.exp(np.clip(lt, -8, 8))
    out = np.where(F >= OLIG_HI, np.inf, out)

def make_cohort(n, fm0_a, fm0_b, cap_sd=0.55, coupling=0.6):
    """Cohort with a Beta-distributed initial Fugl-Meyer score and a corticospinal capacity
    that is correlated with it (severe strokes tend to have less surviving output capacity)."""
    u = rng.beta(fm0_a, fm0_b, n)
    fm0 = u * FM_MAX
    z = coupling * (u - u.mean()) / u.std() + np.sqrt(max(1 - coupling ** 2, 0)) * rng.normal(0, 1, n)
    cap = np.clip(0.9 + cap_sd * z, 0.02, None)
    return fm0, cap

def t_crit(F):
    F = np.asarray(F, dtype=float)
    lt = np.interp(F, _F_ANCH, _LT_ANCH)
    lt = np.where(F < _F_ANCH[0], _LT_ANCH[0] + _SLOPE_LO * (F - _F_ANCH[0]), lt)
    lt = np.where(F > _F_ANCH[-1], _LT_ANCH[-1] + _SLOPE_HI * (F - _F_ANCH[-1]), lt)
    out = np.exp(np.clip(lt, -8, 8))
    out = np.where(F >= OLIG_HI, np.inf, out)
    return np.where(F <= PUMP, 1e-3, out)

def igr_distribution(p, n_quad=None):
    """Joint distribution of the 3-hour growth rate over collateral grade and territory volume,
    returned as (values, weights) so quantiles and proportions follow without simulation."""
    logV, sV = p[3], p[4]
    frac = infarct_fraction(3.0, COLL, p)                      # (n_coll,)
    vols = np.exp(logV + sV * VZ)                              # (n_vol,)
    vals = np.outer(frac, vols) / 3.0

    order = np.argsort(vals.ravel())
    return vals.ravel()[order], w.ravel()[order]

def window_for(enrichment, coverage=0.35, p0=0.40, n=1000):
    """The latest treatment hour at which a carrier with this enrichment still reaches the effect a
    trial of n patients could detect."""
    se = np.sqrt(2 * (1 / (p0 * (1 - p0))) / (n / 2))

    ok = ors >= detect
    return float(th[ok][-1]) if ok.any() else np.nan
